auth.detail: local_noauth — no auth, single admin user. Do not expose publicly without your own auth in front.

ai.detail: OPENROUTER_API_KEY not set (optional) — SAM, the in-app SEO agent, is disabled.

rendering.detail: CONTEXT_API_KEY not set (optional) — on Docker the site audit "Render JavaScript" option is disabled; on Cloudflare, Browser Run renders without a fallback.
